source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Unit 1 (PDF 3-35), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh Unit 1 (Graphical Representation of Functions) ke poore unit se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke Section-II ke sawal ke hisse ki shakal mein: har sawal 5 number ka hai (lamba sawal, saboot (proof) ya derivation). Har sawal poore qadmon ke saath hal kiya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Sketch the graph of \(y = -(x + 3)(x - 1)\) using the method of factors: find the x-intercepts, vertex, end behaviour and y-intercept. (5 marks)
(Factors ke tareeqe se \(y = -(x + 3)(x - 1)\) ka graph banayein: x-intercepts, vertex, end behaviour aur y-intercept maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh \(a(x - h)(x - k)\) shakal mein hai, \(a = -1\), \(h = -3\), \(k = 1\); Case-I ke chaar qadam lagayein.

book_ref.quote: To sketch the graph, follow the given steps:

steps: Points plot kar ke hamwar (smooth) neeche khulne wala parabola banayein
blocks.final_answer: Neeche khulne wala parabola: \((-3, 0)\), \((1, 0)\), vertex \((-1, 4)\), y-intercept \((0, 3)\).

blocks.prompt:
2 Sketch the graph of \(y = 3x^{2} - 12x + 12\) after writing it in factor form. (5 marks)
(\(y = 3x^{2} - 12x + 12\) ko factor form mein likh kar is ka graph banayein.)
blocks.explanation: Common factor 3 nikalein; bracket perfect square hai, is liye Case-II (\(h = k\)).

book_ref.quote: Then follow Steps 3 and 4 of Case-I to complete the sketch of the graph.

steps: Graph x-axis ko sirf \(x = 2\) par chhoota hai: vertex \((2, 0)\)
Points plot kar ke \((2, 0)\) par chhoota hua ooper khulne wala parabola banayein
blocks.final_answer: \(y = 3(x - 2)^{2}\): ooper khulne wala parabola, vertex \((2, 0)\), \((0, 12)\) aur \((4, 12)\) se guzarta hai.

blocks.prompt:
3 A parabola cuts the x-axis at \(x = -4\) and \(x = 2\) and passes through \((1, -10)\). Find its equation in standard form and its vertex. (5 marks)
(Aik parabola x-axis ko \(x = -4\) aur \(x = 2\) par kaatta hai aur \((1, -10)\) se guzarta hai. Is ki standard form equation aur vertex maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Intercepts se factor form likhein, phir teesre point se \(a\) nikalein.

book_ref.quote: If the graph crosses the x-axis at

blocks.prompt:
4 Discuss the domain, range, intercepts, monotonicity and asymptote of \(f(x) = \left(\frac{5}{2}\right)^{x}\), make a table for \(x = -2, \ldots, 2\) and describe its graph. (5 marks)
(\(f(x) = \left(\frac{5}{2}\right)^{x}\) ka domain, range, intercepts, monotonicity aur asymptote batayein, \(x = -2, \ldots, 2\) ki table banayein aur graph bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(a = \frac{5}{2} > 1\) ke saath \(a^{x}\) ki properties, phir chand qeematein.

book_ref.quote: Before sketching the graph of an exponential function, we study its essential properties

steps: Graph: in points se guzarta hua ooper jata hamwar curve, x-axis se ooper

blocks.prompt:
5 Prove that \(f(x) = a^{x}\) is strictly increasing when \(a > 1\) and strictly decreasing when \(0 < a < 1\). Hence show that it is one-to-one. (5 marks)
(Saabit karein ke \(f(x) = a^{x}\) \(a > 1\) par strictly increasing aur \(0 < a < 1\) par strictly decreasing hai. Is se one-to-one hona dikhayein.)
blocks.explanation: \(a^{x_{2}} = a^{x_{1}} \cdot a^{x_{2} - x_{1}}\) likh kar doosre factor ka 1 se mawazna karein.

book_ref.quote: is strictly increasing when \(a > 1\)

steps: Agar \(a^{x_{1}} = a^{x_{2}}\) aur \(x_{1} \ne x_{2}\), to aik doosre se bara hota: na-mumkin
blocks.final_answer: Saabit hua: \(a > 1\) par increasing, \(0 < a < 1\) par decreasing, aur one-to-one.

blocks.prompt:
6 Show that \(\cosh x + \sinh x = e^{x}\) and \(\cosh x - \sinh x = e^{-x}\). Hence prove \(\cosh^{2} x - \sinh^{2} x = 1\) and verify it for \(x = \ln 3\). (5 marks)
(Dikhayein ke \(\cosh x + \sinh x = e^{x}\) aur \(\cosh x - \sinh x = e^{-x}\). Phir \(\cosh^{2} x - \sinh^{2} x = 1\) saabit karein aur \(x = \ln 3\) par tasdeeq karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono definitions jama aur tafreeq karein, phir difference of squares lagayein.

book_ref.quote: The other four are made from them exactly as in trigonometry

blocks.final_answer: Saabit hua: \(\cosh^{2} x - \sinh^{2} x = 1\); \(x = \ln 3\) par bhi \(1\).

blocks.prompt:
7 Show that \(\tanh x = \dfrac{e^{2x} - 1}{e^{2x} + 1}\). Hence show that \(-1 < \tanh x < 1\) for every real \(x\), and find \(\tanh 1\) to four decimal places. (5 marks)
(Dikhayein ke \(\tanh x = \dfrac{e^{2x} - 1}{e^{2x} + 1}\). Phir dikhayein ke har real \(x\) ke liye \(-1 < \tanh x < 1\), aur \(\tanh 1\) chaar decimal tak nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Definition ke upar neeche \(e^{x}\) se zarb dein; phir numerator aur denominator ka mawazna karein.

book_ref.quote: is always smaller in size than its denominator

blocks.prompt:
8 Prove that \(\cosh x \ge 1\) for every real \(x\), with equality only at \(x = 0\). Hence state the range of \(\cosh x\) and show that \(\cosh x\) is even. (5 marks)
(Saabit karein ke har real \(x\) ke liye \(\cosh x \ge 1\), barabari sirf \(x = 0\) par. Phir \(\cosh x\) ki range batayein aur dikhayein ke yeh even hai.)
blocks.explanation: Square kabhi negative nahi: \(\left(e^{x/2} - e^{-x/2}\right)^{2} \ge 0\) se shuru karein.

book_ref.quote: is minimum value of the graph

steps: \(\cosh(-x) = \cosh x\): even, y-axis ke gird symmetric
blocks.final_answer: Saabit hua: \(\cosh x \ge 1\), range \([1, \infty)\), \(\cosh x\) even hai.

blocks.prompt:
9 Prove that \(\sinh^{-1} x = \ln\left(x + \sqrt{x^{2} + 1}\right)\) for every real \(x\). Use it to find \(y\) if \(\sinh y = \frac{12}{5}\), and check your answer. (5 marks)
(Saabit karein ke har real \(x\) ke liye \(\sinh^{-1} x = \ln\left(x + \sqrt{x^{2} + 1}\right)\). Is se \(\sinh y = \frac{12}{5}\) ho to \(y\) nikalein aur tasdeeq karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(x = \sinh y\) rakhein, \(e^{y}\) mein quadratic banayein, negative root radd karein, \(\ln\) lein.

book_ref.quote: it is clear from the horizontal line test that the function is bijective

steps: Minus root hamesha negative, \(e^{y} > 0\): plus sign

blocks.prompt:
10 Prove that \(\cosh^{-1} x = \ln\left(x + \sqrt{x^{2} - 1}\right)\), \(x \ge 1\). Evaluate \(\cosh^{-1}\frac{5}{3}\) and show what the rejected sign would give. (5 marks)
(Saabit karein ke \(\cosh^{-1} x = \ln\left(x + \sqrt{x^{2} - 1}\right)\), \(x \ge 1\). \(\cosh^{-1}\frac{5}{3}\) nikalein aur dikhayein ke radd shuda sign kya deta.)
blocks.explanation: \(\sinh^{-1}\) wala tareeqa; yahan dono roots positive, \(y \ge 0\) sign chunti hai.

book_ref.quote: which is possible only if the positive sign is taken

steps: Dono roots ka product 1: minus root \(\le 1\), us ka \(\ln \le 0\)

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yahan dono roots positive hain, is liye \(e^{y} > 0\) se faisla nahi hota. Faisla \(y \ge 0\) se hota hai: chhota root 1 se kam (ya barabar) hai, us ka \(\ln\) negative, jo \(\cosh^{-1}\) ki range \([0, \infty)\) mein nahi.

blocks.prompt:
11 Prove that \(f(x) = \log_{a} x\) (\(a > 0\), \(a \ne 1\)) is one-to-one, strictly increasing for \(a > 1\) and strictly decreasing for \(0 < a < 1\). Illustrate with \(\log_{2}\) and \(\log_{1/2}\) at \(x = 2\) and \(x = 8\). (5 marks)
(Saabit karein ke \(f(x) = \log_{a} x\) one-to-one hai, \(a > 1\) par strictly increasing aur \(0 < a < 1\) par strictly decreasing. \(x = 2\), \(x = 8\) par \(\log_{2}\) aur \(\log_{1/2}\) se misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Exponential form \(x = a^{y}\) mein badal kar \(a^{y}\) ki maloom properties lagayein.

book_ref.quote: Hence, the logarithmic function is one to one.

steps: \(\log_{a} s = \log_{a} t\) se \(a^{\log_{a} s} = a^{\log_{a} t}\), yani \(s = t\)
blocks.final_answer: Saabit hua: \(\log_{a} x\) one-to-one; \(a > 1\) par increasing, \(0 < a < 1\) par decreasing.

blocks.prompt:
12 Let \(f(x) = 3^{x - 1} + 2\). Find \(f^{-1}(x)\), state the domain and range of \(f\) and \(f^{-1}\), and verify with one point that the graphs are reflections in \(y = x\). (5 marks)
(\(f(x) = 3^{x - 1} + 2\). \(f^{-1}(x)\) nikalein, \(f\) aur \(f^{-1}\) ke domain aur range batayein, aur aik point se tasdeeq karein ke graphs \(y = x\) mein aks hain.)
blocks.explanation: \(f\) one-to-one hai; \(x\) aur \(y\) badal kar \(y\) nikalein.

book_ref.quote: The graph of a function and its inverse are related through a geometric symmetry

blocks.final_answer: \(f^{-1}(x) = 1 + \log_{3}(x - 2)\); domain aur range aapas mein badalte hain.

blocks.prompt:
13 Let \(f(x) = 2^{x}\). Find the function obtained by applying in order: a shift 3 units to the left, a vertical stretch by factor 4 and a shift 2 units downward. Find the new y-intercept and horizontal asymptote. (5 marks)
(\(f(x) = 2^{x}\) par tarteeb se: 3 units baayen shift, factor 4 vertical stretch, 2 units neeche shift. Naya function, y-intercept aur horizontal asymptote nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Har dafa naye function par aik transformation lagayein.

book_ref.quote: Never go back to the original function in the middle.

blocks.prompt:
14 Let \(f(x) = \dfrac{1}{x - 1}\). Find the function obtained by applying in order: a horizontal compression by factor 2, a shift 1 unit to the right, a vertical compression by factor 3 and a shift 2 units upward. (5 marks)
(\(f(x) = \dfrac{1}{x - 1}\) par tarteeb se: factor 2 horizontal compression, 1 unit daayen shift, factor 3 vertical compression, 2 units ooper shift. Naya function nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Har naye function ka naam rakhein; horizontal tabdeeli mein har \(x\) badlein, vertical mein poora function.

book_ref.quote: Write the function you have now and give it a name.

blocks.prompt:
15 Solve the equation \(4^{x} - 6 \cdot 2^{x} + 8 = 0\). (5 marks)
(Equation \(4^{x} - 6 \cdot 2^{x} + 8 = 0\) hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(4^{x} = (2^{x})^{2}\): \(t = 2^{x} > 0\) mein quadratic; phir one-to-one property.

book_ref.quote: Ordinary algebra cannot reach it there

blocks.prompt:
16 Solve \(\log_{2} x + \log_{2}(x - 2) = 3\). (5 marks)
(\(\log_{2} x + \log_{2}(x - 2) = 3\) hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: Pehle domain, phir product law, exponential form, aur domain se bahar roots radd.

book_ref.quote: Several logarithms: join them with the product or quotient law

blocks.prompt:
17 Solve \(\log_{x}(4x - 3) = 2\). (5 marks)
(\(\log_{x}(4x - 3) = 2\) hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: Base aur argument ki sharait likhein, exponential form, hal, phir har root parkhein.

book_ref.quote: here the unknown is also the base

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Is sawal mein \(x = 1\) argument ki shart poori karta hai (\(4 - 3 = 1 > 0\)), magar base 1 jaiz nahi, kyun ke \(1^{y}\) hamesha 1 hai. Is liye sirf \(x = 3\).

blocks.prompt:
18 Solve \(5^{x} = 2^{x + 2}\). Give the exact answer as one logarithm and to four decimal places. (5 marks)
(\(5^{x} = 2^{x + 2}\) hal karein. Jawab aik logarithm ki shakal mein aur chaar decimal tak dein.)
blocks.explanation: Bases barabar nahi ho sakte, is liye dono taraf \(\ln\); equation \(x\) mein linear ban jati hai.

book_ref.quote: Different bases: take logarithms of both sides and use the power law

blocks.prompt:
19 Solve the inequality \(3^{x + 1} < 7^{x}\). (5 marks)
(Inequality \(3^{x + 1} < 7^{x}\) hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: Positive \(3^{x}\) se taqseem, \(\log\) lein (sign wahi), phir \(\log\frac{7}{3} > 0\) (kyun ke \(\frac{7}{3} > 1\)) se taqseem.

book_ref.quote: Being positive is not enough

blocks.prompt:
20 Solve the inequality \(\log_{\frac{2}{3}}(x^{2} - 5x + 4) \ge \log_{\frac{2}{3}}(x - 1)\). (5 marks)
(Inequality \(\log_{\frac{2}{3}}(x^{2} - 5x + 4) \ge \log_{\frac{2}{3}}(x - 1)\) hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono logarithms ka domain; base \(\frac{2}{3} < 1\) sign ulat deta hai; domain se intersection.

book_ref.quote: Keeping the inequality sign when the base is between 0 and 1

blocks.prompt:
21 A bacteria culture grows as \(N = 400e^{kt}\) (\(t\) in hours) and reaches 1000 after 12 hours. Find (i) \(k\) (ii) \(N\) after 24 hours (iii) the time when \(N = 1600\). (5 marks)
(Bacteria culture \(N = 400e^{kt}\) (\(t\) ghanton mein) 12 ghante baad 1000 ho jata hai. (i) \(k\) (ii) 24 ghante baad \(N\) (iii) \(N = 1600\) kab hoga?)
blocks.explanation: Maloom jora rakh kar \(k\) nikalein; \(\ln\) se pehle exponential ko akela karein.

book_ref.quote: Many natural and physical processes such as population growth and radioactive decay

blocks.prompt:
22 A radioactive substance decays as \(N = 900e^{-0.03t}\) (\(t\) in years). Find (i) the amount after 10 years (ii) the time when 300 remains (iii) its half-life. (5 marks)
(Radioactive maadda \(N = 900e^{-0.03t}\) (\(t\) saalon mein). (i) 10 saal baad miqdaar (ii) 300 kab bachega (iii) half-life nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: (i) seedha rakhein; (ii), (iii) mein \(t\) exponent mein hai: \(e^{-0.03t}\) akela kar ke \(\ln\).

book_ref.quote: In growth, the quantity increases with time, while in decay it decreases with time.

blocks.prompt:
23 A machine produces a sound of level 70 dB (\(I_{0} = 10^{-12}\ \text{W/m}^{2}\)). (i) Find its intensity. (ii) A second machine is 100 times as intense. Find its sound level. (iii) What is the level of the threshold intensity? (5 marks)
(Aik machine ki awaz 70 dB hai (\(I_{0} = 10^{-12}\ \text{W/m}^{2}\)). (i) Intensity nikalein. (ii) Doosri machine 100 guna intense hai, us ka level nikalein. (iii) Threshold intensity ka level kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(L = 10\log\frac{I}{I_{0}}\): \(I\) ke liye 10 se taqseem aur exponential form; \(L\) ke liye seedha rakhein.

book_ref.quote: makes logarithmic laws very useful in comparing sound levels in real-life situations

blocks.prompt:
24 Rs. 8000 is invested at 6% per annum for 2 years. Find the amount if interest is compounded (i) monthly (ii) continuously. (iii) At 7% compounded continuously, how long does a sum take to double? (5 marks)
(Rs. 8000, 6% salana, 2 saal. Raqam nikalein agar compounding (i) monthly (ii) continuous ho. (iii) 7% continuous par raqam kitne arse mein dugni hogi?)
blocks.explanation: Discrete: \(n = 12\) ke saath \(A = P\left(1 + \frac{r}{n}\right)^{nt}\); continuous: \(A = Pe^{rt}\); dugna: \(e^{rt} = 2\).

book_ref.quote: Continuous compounding always gives slightly more than any discrete compounding at the same rate.
